articles.title: 'Dr. Doom'-backed Atlas Capital CEO says bitcoin could crash 70% before reaching $500,000
articles.snippet: Backed by economist Nouriel Roubini, a long-time anti-bitcoin advocate, and known as 'Dr. Doom,' the Atlas CEO, Reza Bundy, shot a short-term warning for bitcoin but stayed bullish in the long-term.

articles.title: Strategy's Saylor's explanation for bitcoin's slide isn't what bears think
articles.snippet: Bitcoin's drop reflects capital rotation into AI, Saylor argues, but the bears have a darker reason.

articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin selloff stalls as key indicator signals oversold conditions
articles.snippet: Bitcoin rebounded to $64,000 after a sharp selloff, with the move reflecting a typical bounce from oversold conditions rather than a confirmed trend reversal.

articles.title: About 67% of banned Anthropic accounts used AI to prep for cyberattacks
articles.snippet: AI firm Anthropic mapped a year’s worth of AI-enabled cyber threats, finding that malicious actors are quickly becoming more dangerous with AI.

articles.title: CFTC follows SEC in scrapping ‘no-deny’ policy for settlements
articles.snippet: CFTC Chairman Mike Selig says the rescission of its “no-deny” policy means it now has more flexibility when settling enforcement actions.
